description:
Build the Path Forward

 At Path Robotics, we’re building the future of embodied intelligence. Our AI-driven systems enable robots to adapt, learn, and perform in the real world closing the skilled labor gap and transforming industries. We go beyond traditional methods, combining perception, reasoning, and control to deliver field-ready AI that is risk-aware, reliable, and continuously improving through real-world use.

 Big, hard problems are our everyday work, and our team of intelligent, humble, and driven people make the impossible possible together.

 We're seeking a Robotics Software Engineer to join our Motion Planning team. You'll build and improve the planners that move industrial robot arms through real work. Our robots plan against several goals at once: reachability, collision avoidance, cycle time, and task quality. You'll combine classical planning and optimization with learning-based and data-driven methods, using data from a fleet of production robotic cells to make planning faster and more reliable. Your code runs on live robots doing real work for customers.

 What You'll Do 

 
 Design, build, and improve motion and trajectory planning for robot manipulators, from kinematics and inverse kinematics to collision checking and trajectory optimization, producing fast, feasible motion that meets several objectives at once.

 Model collisions under uncertainty from imperfect sensing, calibration, and scene models, using both geometric and learned models, balancing safety margins with motion efficiency.

 Modify trajectories to correct, adapt, and replan motion as sensor feedback and task requirements change, while keeping it collision-free and feasible.

 Plan for systems with multiple degrees of freedom, including multiple robots working the same part, and sequence their tasks.

 Improve classical planners with learning-based and data-driven methods, such as learned initial guesses for optimization, learned costs, or offline optimization that speeds up online planning.

 Take learned models from prototype to production, with the validation, fallbacks, and monitoring that keep motion safe and correct.

 Turn data from our production fleet into training data, benchmarks, and planning metrics, validate gains in simulation and on live robotic cells, and diagnose failures to their root cause.

 
 Who You Are 

 
 2+ years building robotics software in modern C++. Python is a strong plus.

 Strong foundations in linear algebra, 3D geometry, kinematics, and optimization.

 You've built software that runs on physical robot hardware.

 Fluent developing on Linux with Git, with solid testing habits (unit tests, CI/CD).

 You explain planning tradeoffs clearly in writing and design reviews, and work closely with perception, controls, and field teams.

 A Bachelor's in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent experience.

 
 Preferred 

 
 Experience with both sampling-based and optimization-based planning, and the judgment to know when each fits.

 Experience applying machine learning to planning or control, such as learned proposals or costs, imitation or reinforcement learning, or sim-to-real.

 Planning or collision checking under uncertainty, or online trajectory correction and replanning.

 Multithreading, concurrency, and profiling of performance-critical code.

 
 Why You’ll Love Working Here 

 
 Daily free lunch to keep you fueled and connected with the team

 Flexible PTO so you can take the time you need, when you need it

 Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage

 6 weeks fully paid parental leave, plus an additional 6–8 weeks for birthing parents (12–14 weeks total)

 401(k) retirement plan through Empower

 Generous employee referral bonuses—help us grow our team!

 
 Who We Are 

 At Path Robotics we love coming to work to solve interesting and tough challenges but also because our ideas are welcomed and valued. We encourage unique thinking and are dedicated to creating a diverse and inclusive environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

  

 If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in the application process or any part of the hiring process, please contact HR@path-robotics.co m. We are committed to providing equal access and will work with qualified individuals to ensure a fair and accessible hiring experience. We will respond to your request within 48 hours.
